seo.description: Industrial gas manifolds for cylinder bank distribution. Single-stage, dual-stage, and automatic changeover systems. Supplied from Nagpur.

about: A cylinder manifold connects several cylinders to one supply line so gas flows continuously; when one bank empties the other takes over. Manifolds are used in workshops, laboratories and production lines where changing cylinders by hand would interrupt work.
Manifold design depends on the gas, flow rate and number of cylinders. Share these details with us and we will advise on a suitable system.
